labels.label: risk
labels.reason: SSL compression support is removed, so any deployment that relied on it, even though it was disabled by default, would break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Server and libpq support for the version 2 wire protocol is removed, so older clients using it would fail to connect.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Single-quoted language names in CREATE/DROP LANGUAGE are now disallowed, so existing scripts using that syntax would fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The composite types formerly created for sequences and toast tables are removed, so any queries or tooling referencing them would break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: ecpg now processes doubled quote marks differently, so embedded SQL that worked around the old behavior could change results.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: intarray containment operators no longer use GiST indexes, and the text says indexes created for this purpose should be removed, which requires action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The contrib program pg_standby is removed, so any backup or standby scripts depending on it must be migrated.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: tablefunc's normal_rand() now rejects negative values, so callers passing negative values will see changed behavior or errors.
